Description: A scalable mobile automation platform for provisioning user accounts using real Android devices with centralized orchestration and monitoring.
Architecture: Centralized control layer with web-based dashboard
Distributed execution layer across connected Android devices
Data Flow: Task scheduling and distribution to connected devices
Core Features: Automated account provisioning via native mobile applications
High-throughput parallel execution across multiple devices
Continuous bulk processing via loop-based execution
Automation Engine: Dynamic UI detection with multi-layer fallback selectors
Probabilistic interaction model (gesture variation, randomized input)
Configurable retry mechanism (up to 10 attempts per session)
Session lifecycle management with automated recovery
Device Management: Session isolation and device state reset strategies
Device-level variability handling for execution consistency
Performance Metrics: Average execution time: 5–6 minutes per account
Resilience Features: Fallback execution flows for variable app states
Retry handling for conditional verification steps
Challenges: Adapting to dynamic UI changes across app versions
Maintaining stability across long-running distributed executions
Handling inconsistent application states and edge cases
Designing extensible fallback systems to minimize maintenance overhead
Testing: End-to-end verification via logs and output validation
